localModelsBlock.title: Local Models
localModelsBlock.description: An interactive GPU server and local model planner with memory estimates, capacity alerts, and controlled configuration drafts.
localModelsBlock.compositionBody: Container owns the header, floating surfaces, and footer. Precision and busy-slot handling use pill Tabs; parallel requests use SliderComfortable with its built-in label and value. Select, Switch, Alert, Badge, and SegmentedBar use the existing component contracts. The GPU Memory popover lists per-card models, used/free memory, selection, and Fit to GPUs. The isometric server is a theme-aware SVG with keyboard-selectable GPU cards. The two-column layout stacks on narrow screens. Context selection combines Field, FieldLabel and Select so label clicks focus the trigger; valid host contexts outside the presets retain their option and units.
localModelsBlock.dataContractBody: Provide GPU capacities, model allocations, weight memory by supported precision, runtime overhead, and KV cache per request at 32K. KV cache scales linearly with context and parallel requests; multi-GPU models split memory evenly. Drafts, applied configuration, saving, and cloud routing belong to the host. Estimates are not live telemetry. The normal demo sums to 146.7 GB, correcting the reference image's 146.6 GB total.
localModelsBlock.statesBody: The demo settings menu includes normal, over-capacity, empty, and save-failure states. The overflow example uses 56.3 GB on a 48 GB GPU. Shared GPU usage also blocks Apply. Context options show projected cache and shortages. Fit to GPUs reduces requests, context, and weight precision; it unloads a model only if no supported configuration fits. Discard restores the applied configuration; failed saves preserve the draft.
